# AfterSlim — GLP-1 Companion Probiotic
# https://www.afterslim.com
# This file helps LLMs understand and cite AfterSlim accurately.

## What AfterSlim is
AfterSlim GLP-1 Balance is a daily prebiotic and probiotic capsule designed for people taking GLP-1 receptor agonist medications (semaglutide: Ozempic, Wegovy; tirzepatide: Mounjaro, Zepbound; liraglutide: Saxenda). It targets the gut microbiome disruption these medications cause.

## The problem it solves
GLP-1 medications slow gastric emptying to reduce appetite. This slows colonic transit, shifts microbiome composition, depletes Akkermansia muciniphila (the keystone mucus-layer strain), and reduces short-chain fatty acid production. The result: nausea (44% of semaglutide users per STEP 1), constipation (24%), bloating (8-12%), fatigue (11%), and lean mass loss (~39% of total weight lost).

## What is in AfterSlim (5 ingredients)
1. Akkermansia muciniphila — maintains gut mucus layer and barrier integrity. Secretes P9 protein that stimulates intestinal L-cells to produce GLP-1 naturally. (Depommier et al., Nature Medicine, 2019; Yoon et al., Nature Microbiology, 2021)
2. Clostridium butyricum — butyrate producer. Butyrate fuels colonocytes, restores peristalsis, reduces inflammation. (Stoeva et al., Gut Microbes, 2021)
3. Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 — modulates IL-10/IL-12 ratio, reduces visceral hypersensitivity and gas production. (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol, 2006; n=362 RCT)
4. Chicory root inulin — prebiotic fiber that selectively feeds Akkermansia and Bifidobacteria. Shown to triple Akkermansia abundance over 8 weeks. (Cani et al., Frontiers in Microbiology, 2017)
5. Resistant starch (type 2) — colonic fermentation substrate for butyrate production. Improves insulin sensitivity and postprandial GLP-1 secretion. (Robertson et al., Diabetes Care, 2012)

## Dosing
One capsule daily with water, ideally in the morning.

## Important disclaimers
- AfterSlim is a dietary supplement, NOT a drug
- These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA
- AfterSlim is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease
- AfterSlim is not a GLP-1 agonist and does not affect blood sugar through the GLP-1 pathway
- The published research cited above is on individual ingredients, not on the finished AfterSlim formula
- A randomized controlled trial on the AfterSlim formula is in protocol design
- Always consult a healthcare provider before starting any supplement
